_schema.rule: Every new feature entry MUST include both `system_1_source` (named target — note: the predictive System-1 thesis was empirically refuted 2026-05-01; this field now means 'named target', not 'encoded reflex') AND `outcome_metric` (named measurable metric + 90-day threshold + kill criterion). The `outcome_metric` block is the active discipline replacing the demoted System-1 lens. Features missing `outcome_metric` are invalid. See `memory/feedback_outcome_metric_first.md` and `~/Vaults/JKKNKB/Strategy/Bharathiraja-Test-Verdict-2026-05-01.md`.

system_1_source_fields.expert_role: Named role/person whose reflex is being encoded (or 'infra' if none)
system_1_source_fields.reflex_being_encoded: One-sentence description of the tacit pattern
system_1_source_fields.obvious_reading: What 90% of people would say this expert is doing
system_1_source_fields.hidden_pattern: What the expert actually pattern-matches on unconsciously (PENDING /think-aloud if not yet captured)
system_1_source_fields.juicero_validation: Answer to: if encoded perfectly and run 24/7, what changes / who notices / what metric moves?

outcome_metric_fields.metric_name: Queryable database column / dashboard chart / Supabase function output. Single number or yes/no on verdict-date. NOT 'improve X' or 'better Y'.
outcome_metric_fields.threshold_90d: Target value at verdict-date (90 days from spec lock). Specific number.
outcome_metric_fields.kill_criterion: If threshold missed by X%, module is revised or formally archived. Specific value + specific consequence.
outcome_metric_fields.verdict_date: ISO date — 90 days from spec lock

_schema.enforcement: Specs missing `outcome_metric` block are invalid. /myjkkn-chain Q0 (Outcome Metric Lock) enforces this gate at spec-time. The four-test-discipline gate enforces it at audit-time (Juicero test = 'named metric'). At verdict_date, query the metric; if HIT or MISS-tolerance, update verdict_status; if MISS below kill_criterion, revise architecture or formally archive — do NOT defend. Cross-domain commitments also captured via /lock-initiative skill at ~/Vaults/JKKNKB/Strategy/Locked-Initiatives.md.

features.name: Counselor rules-engine — spec + 7-phase build (Phases 1+2 shipped)

system_1_source.expert_role: Senior counselor (Bharathiraja et al.) — Inventory R-001
system_1_source.reflex_being_encoded: Lead-quality intuition on first call: which lead to call first, which to deprioritize, which message tone to use
system_1_source.obvious_reading: Counselors follow lead scoring rules and call top-down by score
system_1_source.hidden_pattern: PENDING /think-aloud Q2 — believed signals: phone-prefix demographic inference, time-of-form-submission tier, message-length intent signal, school-name brand recognition, parent-vs-student language. Validate via case-walking with Bharathiraja before encoding.
